headline_marked: Cyclone Murasu: [[Severe cyclonic storm to cross India's coast]] tonight
headline: Cyclone Murasu: Severe cyclonic storm to cross India's coast tonight
summary: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department warns of wind speeds up to 117 kph, prompting cautionary signals at several maritime ports.
details: Severe cyclonic storm Murasu, formed over the Bay of Bengal, is expected to cross the Andhra Pradesh coast of India by Monday night.
The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has instructed the maritime ports of Chattogram, Cox’s Bazar, Mongla, and Payra to keep hoisting local cautionary signal No. 2.
The storm is currently located approximately 1,275 kilometres from Mongla Port and 1,295 kilometres from Payra Port, moving northwestwards.
Maximum sustained wind speeds within 64km of the storm's center are 89 kph, with gusts or squalls reaching up to 117 kph.
The BMD has advised all fishing boats and trawlers operating in the North Bay to remain close to the coast and proceed with caution until further notice.
caption:
Wind speeds up to 117 kph! Cyclone Murasu is heading for the Indian coast.

Severe cyclonic storm Murasu, formed over the Bay of Bengal, is expected to cross the Andhra Pradesh coast of India by Monday night.

The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has instructed the maritime ports of Chattogram, Cox’s Bazar, Mongla, and Payra to keep hoisting local cautionary signal No. 2.

The storm is currently located approximately 1,275 kilometres from Mongla Port and 1,295 kilometres from Payra Port, moving northwestwards.

Maximum sustained wind speeds within 64km of the storm's center are 89 kph, with gusts or squalls reaching up to 117 kph.

The BMD has advised all fishing boats and trawlers operating in the North Bay to remain close to the coast and proceed with caution until further notice.
